_doc: The planet's look: what its env script and the shared sky, map and audio helpers read (PlanetDefinition.look()). world_type: a label for tools. sky / fog / sun / ambient / night / restored: values the env script applies (its own meaning per planet; colours are [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a]). palette: key colours by role. junk_tint: the coat on junk [r, g, b, strength]. globe: the map globe (PlanetGlobe): seed, tilt and face (radians), spin (rad/s), au (light falloff), optional clouds {col_ruin, col_ok, cover_*, opacity_*, scale, band, storms, swirl, storm_size, sharp}, atmo {col_ruin, col_ok, strength_ruin, strength_ok, thickness, falloff} and ring (dust | ice | fire). orbit: this planet's place round the binary star (SolarSystem.planet): orbit_au, tilt_deg, sep_deg and sep_angle_deg (the companion sun's separation and direction), day_length_s, moons, day_stars. Other keys are flags the env script reads (no_lakes, pieces_mult, junk_biome, prefer_biome, district, exposure...).
